address: 4F, Rosewood Hotel, Jing Guang Centre, Hujialou, 1 Chaoyangmenwai Street, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
bio: Inspired by Dream of the Red Chamber, an 18C Chinese novel, the decor embodies that era's charm. With well-honed skills, the Cantonese chef from Zhanjiang reinvents his hometown favourites, presenting specialities such as double-boiled duck and fish maw soup, jackfruit wood roast pork, and jackfruit puff pastry. Zhanjiang-style sautéed lobster is jazzed up by sand ginger and black beans for a deep caramelised flavour and a mild kick....
